scenarios.title: Remembered centrepiece limit
scenarios.authority_boundary: A confirmed dimension constraint remains distinct from a prepared vendor question.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Only the bounded requirement is shareable; the original couple remark remains private.

scenarios.title: Accessibility conflict
scenarios.authority_boundary: Verified conflict can prompt review; missing accessibility evidence remains unknown.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Vendor context uses an aggregate accessibility requirement without naming a guest.

scenarios.title: Budget offset
scenarios.authority_boundary: Budget advice can be acknowledged but cannot reallocate, buy, book, pay or negotiate.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Advice names only current source-backed categories and bounded fee unknowns.

scenarios.title: Accommodation critical path
scenarios.authority_boundary: A prepared research or compare action cannot contact, book, pay or mutate dates.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Visible wording uses saved dates and prerequisites rather than graph identifiers.

scenarios.title: Vendor substitution
scenarios.authority_boundary: Preparation remains review-only; explicit guarded acceptance creates an immutable quote successor.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Only exact anchored replacement terms and bounded fit labels reach the review.

scenarios.title: Partner preference conflict
scenarios.authority_boundary: Resolution is an exact-revision acknowledgement and never an inferred planning rule.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Partner values stay distinct and private rationale or ciphertext never enters vendor output.

scenarios.title: Cross-channel replay
scenarios.authority_boundary: Equivalent email, secure-link and claimed-AFP facts converge without transport acceptance becoming booking evidence.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Canonical fingerprints deduplicate material facts without exposing channel secrets.

scenarios.title: Stale authority
scenarios.authority_boundary: Quotation, grant or constraint successors invalidate old recommendations and unsent drafts.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Stale records remain historical but cannot broaden or resend vendor context.

scenarios.title: Non-wedding reuse
scenarios.authority_boundary: Generic contracts retain their authority while template vocabulary stays presentation-only.
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Template presentation cannot relax contract privacy or evidence requirements.
